analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see for 3 consecutive sessions. Today's RSI at 37.8, down from 41.4 five days ago, continuing downtrend into oversold territory. MACD histogram also worsened from -1266.0973 to -2535.7217, reinforcing bearish momentum. ADX at 24.4 indicates early trend formation, warranting caution. While the 5-day and 20-day lows at 1,027,000 suggest a potential Higher Low pattern, weakening trend indicators advise against immediate buying.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI entering oversold and MACD weakening, conditions for holding wait-and-see and deferring buy entry.
